docs.title: Eberron MCP Server
docs.text: An MCP server that gives AI assistants access to information about the Eberron Dungeons & Dragons campaign setting — capitals of its nations and live lookups against the Eberron Fandom Wiki.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
The server runs as a Docker container and exposes an MCP endpoint over Streamable HTTP on port 8000.

docker run -p 8000:8000 sinanozel/eberron-mcp-server:latest

MCP endpoint:

http://localhost:8000/mcp

docs.title: Tools
docs.text:
Tool Description get_capital Returns the capital city of an Eberron nation search_eberron_wiki Searches the Eberron Fandom Wiki for lore

See the Tools page for full input/output details.

docs.title: Running Locally for Development
docs.text:
The only requirement is Docker.

git clone https://github.com/sinanozel/eberron-mcp-server.git
cd eberron-mcp-server

# Run the MCP Inspector (browser UI)
docker compose -f inspector/docker-compose.yaml up --build
# Then open http://localhost:6274

# Run tests
docker compose -f tests/docker-compose.yaml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from test

# Lint
docker compose -f lint/docker-compose.yaml up --build --abort-on-container-exit

# Reformat
docker compose -f reformat/docker-compose.yaml up --build --abort-on-container-exit

docs.title: get_capital
docs.text:
Returns the capital city of an Eberron nation.

Input

Field Type Description nation string Nation name, case-insensitive. Null values are rejected.

Supported nations

Nation Capital Aundair Fairhaven Breland Wroat Cyre Metrol Darguun Rhukaan Draal Droaam the Great Craag Eldeen Reaches Greenheart Karrnath Korth Lhazaar Principalities Regalport Mror Holds Krona Peak Q'barra Newthrone Talenta Plains Gatherhold Thrane Flamekeep Valenar Taer Valaestas Zilargo Trolanport

Output

The capital city name as a string, or "Unknown nation" if the input doesn't match any supported nation.

Example

Input:  { "nation": "Breland" }
Output: "Wroat"

Input:  { "nation": "eldeen-reaches" }
Output: "Greenheart"

Input:  { "nation": "Mordain" }
Output: "Unknown nation"

Name matching

The tool normalises spacing and hyphens, so eldeen-reaches, eldeen reaches, and EldeenReaches all resolve correctly.

docs.title: search_eberron_wiki
docs.text:
Queries the Eberron Fandom Wiki for a given term and returns the article content.

Input

Field Type Description query string Article title or search term. Null values are rejected.

Output

Raw HTML content of the matched wiki article, returned as a single string. If the wiki returns an error or the article is not found, the tool returns an error message.

Example

Input:  { "query": "House Cannith" }
Output: "<html>...</html>"  (full article HTML from the Fandom Wiki)

Input:  { "query": "Treaty of Throne" }
Output: "<html>...</html>"

Usage guidance

Pass exact article titles when possible (e.g. "Sharn", "Droaam", "Mourning"). The Fandom API resolves redirects automatically.
